topic: Separation of Concerns: Isolating I/O from pure computation engines
principle: Keep computation engines (VMs, interpreters, evaluators) free of I/O side effects by extracting database, network, and filesystem operations into separate adapter layers. The engine should accept and return plain data structures, never calling I/O directly.
instruction: When a VM or execution engine has grown entangled with database calls, refactor by extracting all I/O into a dedicated trait-based adapter, leaving the engine as a pure function from input state to output state.
